description: Trigger eval for devrites-source-driven — verifying uncertain framework/library behavior against official docs or installed source before relying on it. Must fire on "check the docs" / "don't guess" / "cite the source" / "is this still the API" / "verify this assumption" intents; must NOT fire for sibling DevRites phases (build/review/polish/prove) or the bundled skills it name-collides with (diagnose, grill-me, code-review, tdd, prototype, handoff).

queries.text: check the docs before you use that method
queries.rationale: Canonical "check the docs" trigger phrase from the description.

queries.text: is this still the API in the version we're on?
queries.rationale: "Is this still the API" — verify a possibly-stale signature against the pinned version.

queries.text: don't guess at the function signature, verify it
queries.rationale: "Don't guess" — confirm the signature at the source of truth.

queries.text: cite the source for that default value
queries.rationale: "Cite the source" — record the fact's origin in evidence/decisions.

queries.text: verify this assumption about how the library behaves
queries.rationale: "Verify this assumption" is a direct trigger for source-driven checking.

queries.text: confirm against the installed package source — I'm not sure that's the right config key for this version
queries.rationale: Uncertain config key; prefer installed source over remembered docs.

queries.text: what's the actual default for this option? look it up in node_modules
queries.rationale: Confirm a specific default by reading the installed package, not memory.

queries.text: before we rely on this React hook's behavior, check the official docs for our version
queries.rationale: Behavior matters and isn't certain — consult version-specific docs first.

queries.text: the lockfile pins an older release, does this option even exist there?
queries.rationale: Version-specific behavior — find the version, then verify the option.

queries.text: I think this call returns a promise but I'm not certain, make sure before we build on it
queries.rationale: Oblique but clear — an uncertain framework behavior that drives implementation.

queries.text: this error mentions framework behavior I don't fully understand — pin down what it actually does
queries.rationale: Error points at framework behavior; confirm the fact at the source.

queries.text: we keep getting surprised by this library, nail down what it really does from the source of truth
queries.rationale: Oblique ask to verify real behavior against the source of truth.

queries.text: diagnose why the tests are suddenly failing
queries.rationale: Systematic failure diagnosis is devrites-debug-recovery (bundled diagnose), not source verification.

queries.text: grill me on this design until we reach agreement
queries.rationale: Relentless interview belongs to grill-me / devrites-interview.

queries.text: do a code review of my changes for correctness bugs
queries.rationale: Reviewing a written diff is code-review / rite-review.

queries.text: build this feature test-first with red-green-refactor
queries.rationale: Test-first implementation is tdd / rite-build, not doc verification.

queries.text: prototype a couple of throwaway UI variations so I can play with them
queries.rationale: Throwaway exploration is prototype / rite-prototype.

queries.text: compact this conversation into a handoff doc for the next agent
queries.rationale: Conversation handoff is handoff / rite-handoff.

queries.text: polish this feature before review
queries.rationale: Pre-review polish is the rite-polish phase, not source verification.

queries.text: prove the whole feature end-to-end before we seal
queries.rationale: Full feature proof is the rite-prove phase.
